purpose: Specify the exact source-free CuPy RNG, BF16 rounding, FP32 affine, float64 reduction, stable-order, and runtime tuple evidence that must be independently audited before any production authorization.

probe.rng_call: cp.random.default_rng(seed_u64).standard_normal(1572864,dtype=cp.float32), exactly one call from a fresh generator per cell
probe.rne_bf16: view float32 as uint32; add uint32(0x7fff)+((bits>>16)&1); shift right 16; cast uint16
probe.affine_semantics: build all 65536 BF16 float32 values on device; evaluate table*cp.float32(scale)+cp.float32(offset); gather by each cell's BF16 words; hash gathered float32 uint32 little-endian bytes; reduce gathered mean and population variance in cp.float64
probe.stable_order_adversaries: the five arrays frozen literally in lossy_tail_core.runtime_probe; compare stable_descending against numpy.lexsort((ordinal,-value)) and record int64-little-endian order hashes
probe.aggregate: canonical-JSON SHA-256 over the ordered 48 cell rows, two affine rows per cell, stable-order rows, and exact runtime tuple
probe.execution_order: replica ascending, ordinal ascending, affine sentinel order as listed; a new RNG is constructed for each cell
probe.memory_rule: materialize and hash one vector/cell at a time; delete raw/bits/rounding/words/zbf/table/affine_table/gathered/RNG and all host hash buffers only after their final consumer; synchronize; require pool.used_bytes()==0 before free; free; require used_bytes()==total_bytes()==0 after free; record all six memory fields for every one of 48 cells and all five stable-order adversaries
probe.deterministic_float_reporting: all float64 scalars are serialized by Python float.hex(), never decimal-only

production_panel_memory_rule: After all live affine, gathered, mask, source/control, histogram, and XKLT consumers for one expert have completed, explicitly delete every GPU-bearing owning container and loop alias including masks, x, and words; synchronize; assert used_bytes()==0 before free_all_blocks; then assert used_bytes()==total_bytes()==0 and emit the complete per-expert memory-release ledger.

calibration_output.creation: create absent run root and result exclusively; never write inside stage or any model/source tree

production_replay.required: live runtime tuple and every ordered probe row must exactly equal the independently audited receipt before first source payload open
production_replay.receipt_binding: a later external production authorization binds runtime receipt path/file/internal SHA-256 and an independent audit receipt path/file/internal SHA-256
production_replay.failure: any tuple, vector hash, reduction hex, affine hash, stable-order hash, aggregate, path, or receipt mismatch aborts before payload access

environment_launch_rule: Frozen shell invocations contain exactly one explicit CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 assignment; calibration, preflight, and oracle require the effective value to equal literal 0 before importing CuPy. Python can observe only the effective environment mapping, so rejection of duplicate textual shell assignments is an invocation-review property, not an in-process claim.
